description: Pins the state-snapshot schema used by oracle game-state parity verification. Each entry holds a tic number and per-component SHA-256 hashes for automap, player, rng, sectors, thinkers, plus a combined hash derived from the concatenation of the individual component hashes in ASCIIbetical order. The default sampling interval is 35 tics (one second at the 35 Hz tic rate).
